{{Quote|Within the Nakgru Holocron, I learned the history of the Sith Purebloods in vivid detail not found through oral histories or brittle scrolls. I learned these warlike people are living proof that the smug Jedi who banished us are wrong about the dark side.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''Holocron of King Nakgru''', also known as the '''Nakgru Holocron''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]]. The [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] eventually came be be placed inside the [[Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla]], a sacred [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tomb that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where it lay undisturbed for over ten thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="Book of Sith" /> In [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sorzus Syn]] penetrated the Sanctum of Sakkra-Kla and discovered the Nakgru Holocron. She subsequently studied the device and learned from it the history of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith Purebloods]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
